dialog.english:
Joe, what's wrong? You're spacing
out.
dialog.translation:
¿Qué te pasa, Joe? Estás en
las nubes.

dialog.english:
It's nothing. I was thinking about
all the things that happened to us
since we came here.
dialog.translation:
No es nada. Pensaba en todo lo
que nos ha ocurrido desde que
llegamos.

dialog.english:
Yeah, yeah, a lot of things
happened!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí, sí, pasaron un montón
de cosas!

dialog.english:
I was just supposed be at camp
with everyone...
dialog.translation:
Se supone que debería estar
en el campamento...

dialog.english:
And then we ran into all these
Digimon, and we're wandering
around in this strange world...
dialog.translation:
Y luego todos estos Digimon, y
vagando en este mundo extraño...

dialog.english: Strange world... how rude, Joe!

I-I'm sorry! But there's also
those black gears that make
peaceful Digimon go berserk...
dialog.translation:
¡Lo siento! Pero también están
esas ruedas negras que vuelven
locos a los Digimon...

dialog.english: Yeah, those black gears are scary.
dialog.translation: Sí, esas ruedas dan mucho miedo.

dialog.english:
But we've pulled through with the
power of evolution!
dialog.translation:
¡Pero hemos salido adelante
gracias a la digievolución!

dialog.english:
I guess all we can do is try to
find a way back home as soon as
possible.
dialog.translation:
Supongo que todo lo que podemos
hacer es buscar un modo de volver
a casa.

dialog.english:
You're worrying too much! Joe,
I'll protect you.
Okay...
I-it's cold...
I'm wilting...
But the cold's not a bad thing.
dialog.translation: No es malo que haga frío.

dialog.english: Ehhh?!

Because if it snows, we can have a
snowball fight and make snow huts!
dialog.translation:
¡Si nieva, podemos hacer peleas
de bolas de nieve y muñecos!

dialog.english:
I haven't been in a snowball fight
in a long time!
dialog.translation:
¡No he tirado bolas de nieve en
años!

dialog.english:
What's that?
What's a "snowball fight"?
dialog.translation:
¿Qué es eso?
¿Pelea de bolas de nieve?

dialog.english:
It's a game where you fight by
hitting each other with snowballs.
dialog.translation:
Un juego donde combates tirando a
otros pelotas hechas de nieve.

dialog.english: Okay, and what are snow huts?
I bet it's some kind of food!

Everyone's taking it easy. But if
the temperature drops lower, it'll 
be even harder to set up camp.
dialog.translation:
Todo el mundo se relaja, pero si
la temperatura baja más va a ser
difícil acampar.

dialog.english:
And it'll be hard to get food. I'm
the one who has to protect
everyone.
dialog.translation:
Y será difícil conseguir comida.
Tengo que protegerlos a todos.

dialog.english: Because I'm the oldest...
So what do we do now?

Let's keep going! Nothing's gonna
happen if we stay around here
doing nothing.
dialog.translation:
¡Sigamos adelante! Parados aquí
no pintamos nada.

dialog.english: What? Through these snowfields?
We can't keep going like this!

But there's a snowfield in front
of us and a mountain behind us. So
we have to keep going somehow!
dialog.translation:
Hay paraje nevado delante,
montaña detrás. ¡No es que
tengamos muchas opciones!

dialog.english:
Hold on a second. I smell
something strange...
dialog.translation:
Espera un segundo... huele
a algo raro, ¿no?

dialog.english: ...Could it be...
Ah! Over there!
There's smoke that way!
That's the smell of hot springs!
It... it's boiling!

So that means we can't take a
bath...
But it's nice and warm here!
At least it's not cold anymore.
dialog.translation: Por lo menos no hace frío.

dialog.english:
How can you be so calm about this?
What are we going to do about
food? Food and...
dialog.translation:
¿Cómo podéis estar tan calmados?
¿Qué haremos con la comida? Comida
y...

dialog.english: There's food, look!

Why is there a refrigerator in a
place like this?!
dialog.translation:
¡¿Por qué hay una nevera en un
lugar así?!

dialog.english: Ahhh! We're in luck!
This is ridiculous! It's absurd...
Wanna go play in the snow?

Wait! I can't leave until I find
out what's in that fridge!
dialog.translation:
¡Para! ¡No puedo irme hasta saber
qué hay en esa nevera!

dialog.english: I wonder what's in there?
All right! Let's open it!
Eggs!

Looks like this'll be today's
dinner!

Wait a minute! We can't go around
eating other people's food.
dialog.translation:
¡Espera un momento! No podemos
comer la comida de otros.

dialog.english:
Wouldn't that just make us
burglars?

But we don't have much choice.
We're all starving.
dialog.translation:
Pero no tenemos elección...
Nos morimos de hambre.

dialog.english:
If we told the owners about the
situation, they'd understand.
dialog.translation:
Si se lo contásemos a los
propietarios, lo entenderían.

dialog.english: At any rate, it's an emergency.
dialog.translation: Sea como sea, es una emergencia.

dialog.english: Let's eaaaat!
Let's eat...

What's wrong, Joe? Aren't you
going to eat?

I was thinking about how we
wouldn't have to go through all
this if we were home.
dialog.translation:
Estaba pensando en cómo no
tendríamos que sufrir así si
estuviésemos en casa.

dialog.english:
Hey, everyone! How do you like to
eat your fried eggs?
dialog.translation:
¡Eh chicos! ¿Cómo os gusta comer
los huevos fritos?

dialog.english:
I eat my eggs with salt and
pepper! Is there any other way to
eat them?
dialog.translation:
¡Yo los como con sal y pimienta!
¿Es que existe otra manera?

dialog.english: I put soy sauce on mine!
Mayonnaise.
Worcestershire sauce for me!

I like it with a little citrus
sauce.
dialog.translation: Yo con un poco de salsa cítrica.

dialog.english:
You're all weird! I eat my fried
eggs with sugar! I love putting
fermented soybeans on it, too!
dialog.translation:
¡Pero qué raros sois! ¡Yo como los
huevos con azúcar! ¡Y con 
soja fermentada, también!

dialog.english: Fermented soybeans?!...

You all put those strange things
on your eggs...?
dialog.translation:
¿Pero qué clase de porquería
echáis en los huevos?

dialog.english:
You should put salt and pepper on 
your eggs! Not Worcestershire 
sauce or mayonnaise!
dialog.translation:
¡Los huevos se comen con sal y
pimienta! ¡No mayonesa o
Worcester-lo-que-sea!

dialog.english:
Joe, you're so stubborn. Always
worrying about little things...
dialog.translation:
Joe, te empeñas mucho. Siempre
con las nimiedades...

dialog.english: What do you mean, I'm stubborn?!

See, look! You get angry so
quickly!
Hey, Joe! Calm down!

Be quiet! I am being calm! I'm
always...

You're not acting normal today.
Are you tired?

I'm not tired! All of you are the
ones who aren't normal here!
dialog.translation:
¡No estoy cansado! ¡Sois vosotros
los que estáis raros!

dialog.english:
I've got myself together. I...
I've got myself together!

Honestly, I wish Joe would ease up
a bit. He's always like this...
dialog.translation:
Francamente, ojalá Joe se 
relajase un poco. Está siempre
así...

dialog.english: We've got no choice but to go!
No, there's got to be a safer way!

What's going on? What are they
fighting about?

They're fighting over whether or
not we should go up that mountain 
over there, Infinity Mountain.
dialog.translation:
Se pelean para decidir si debemos
ir o no allí, el Monte Mugen.

dialog.english:
If we climb it, we'll get a good
view of the area! If we chicken
out, we'll just be stuck here!
dialog.translation:
¡Si subimos, tendremos una buena
vista de toda la zona! ¡No
hay que ser gallina!

dialog.english:
You're just charging in blindly.
You're going to put everyone in
danger!
dialog.translation:
Vas como pollo sin cabeza. 
¡Pondrás a todo el mundo en
peligro!

dialog.english:
There are a lot of ferocious
Digimon on that mountain.
dialog.translation:
Hay muchos Digimon feroces
en esa montaña.

dialog.english: Joe! Stop them!

Both of you! We should calm down
and talk this over!
dialog.translation:
¡Vosotros dos! ¡A calmarse
y hablar con calma!

dialog.english: Then what do you think, Joe?
Who do you agree with?

(We'll get a good view of the area
if we go up that mountain, but
there are also ferocious Digimon.)
dialog.translation:
(Tendríamos una buena vista de la
zona si subimos, pero también hay
feroces Digimon.)

dialog.english: Both of you are right
Tai is right
Matt is right

Geez, you're unreliable! Anyway,
we should go as far as we can!
dialog.translation:
¡Pues vaya ayuda! ¡En fin,
deberíamos ir tan lejos como
podamos!

dialog.english: No we shouldn't!
Both of you, listen to me!
See, look!

I'm just trying to think about
everyone's safety!
dialog.translation:
¡Sólo intento pensar en la
seguridad de todos!

dialog.english: Give it up, Tai.
So what are we going to do now?!

Stop! That's enough, the three of
you!

It's getting late, so we'll figure
this out tomorrow!
All right, let's go to bed!
Okay. Nobody's awake...

If I climb Infinity Mountain, I
can figure out what we should do.
dialog.translation:
Si subo al Monte Mugen, podré
decidir qué debemos hacer.

dialog.english:
I... I have to keep myself
together!

You can do anything as long as you
have fighting spirit, right?
dialog.translation:
Haces lo que te propongas siempre
y cuando tengas espíritu, ¿no?

dialog.english:
Tai, we're going to end up like
boiled octopus at this rate!
dialog.translation:
Tai, ¡vamos a parecer pulpo cocido
si seguimos así!

dialog.english:
It really is boiling. I'm
disappointed.

But we shouldn't be wasting time
in hot springs now anyway.
dialog.translation:
No deberíamos perder el tiempo
en aguas termales.

dialog.english:
You're right, but I'm still
disappointed.
dialog.translation: Cierto, pero aun así es una pena.

dialog.english: Let's talk about camp.
Let's talk about camp.
Let's talk about camp.
Let's talk about camp.

Joe, what would you associate with
hot springs?
dialog.translation:
Joe, ¿qué te viene a la mente
con las termas?

dialog.english: I'd say hot spring boiled eggs!
I'd say hot spring steamed buns!

Really...? I don't really like
soft-boiled eggs.
dialog.translation:
¿Sí? No me gustan mucho los
huevos cocidos.

dialog.english: Ah. Really?

I would as well!
I would definitely say the hot
spring souvenir steamed buns.
dialog.translation:
¡Diría lo mismo!
¡Los típicos bollos al vapor
que hay de souvenir!

dialog.english:
I wonder if Digimon also bathe in
hot springs...
dialog.translation:
¿Los Digimon también se bañarán
en termas?

dialog.english:
These really are what you'd call
"hot springs".
dialog.translation:
La verdad, esta agua sí está
que arde.

dialog.english: I bet we could make boiled eggs!
Maybe a monkey will come to bathe!

Yeah, yeah! I love eating hot
spring boiled eggs with sugar and
fermented soybeans!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí, sí! ¡Me encantan los huevos
cocidos con azúcar y
soja fermentada!

dialog.english: Ehh? That, uh, sounds good.

Eh? I'm kind of scared of monkeys,
I wouldn't want that to happen.
dialog.translation:
¿Eh? Los monos me asustan, no me
gustaría que ocurriese eso.

dialog.english: Really? But they're so cute...
I wonder why it's boiling?

Joe, what do you think of when you
hear "hot springs"?
dialog.translation:
Joe, ¿qué te viene a la mente con
las termas?

dialog.english: I'd say the bath clothes!
I'd say the Japanese-style rooms!

I'm bad at wearing bath clothes.
The sash always comes off before I
wake up in the morning.
dialog.translation:
No soy fan de la ropa de baño.
Siempre se me cae cuando me
despierto por la mañana.

dialog.english:
That's because of your sleeping
posture, not the bath clothes.
dialog.translation:
Eso es por cómo duermes, no
culpa de la ropa de baño.

dialog.english:
Yeah! The rooms with floor mats
are so nice! It really makes it
feel like you're at a hot spring!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! Las salas con sus tapetes en
el suelo están genial. ¡Te hacen
sentir como en las termas!

dialog.english:
I want to be in one of those now,
too...
dialog.translation:
Me gustaría estar en una sala
así, ahora.

dialog.english:
I wonder what's going on at the
bottom of those springs?
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto qué hay bajo las
aguas.

dialog.english:
Speaking of hot springs, I wonder
if there's table tennis?
I've never played table tennis.
I played arcade games.
Really? It's a lot of fun.

Is that so? Then next time we go
to a hot spring, I'll challenge
you to table tennis!
dialog.translation:
¿De veras? ¡La siguiente vez que
vayamos a unas termas, te echo
una al ping pong!

dialog.english:
Sure, Any kind of challenge, I'll
take you on!
dialog.translation:
¡Muy bien, te ganaré a cualquier
reto!

dialog.english:
I don't really play arcade games
whether or not I'm at hot springs.
dialog.translation:
No juego a máquinas arcade, 
dentro o fuera de hoteles
termales.

dialog.english:
Hot spring arcade games are
different, though.
dialog.translation:
Las arcade de las termas son
otro rollo...

dialog.english: Hm, I don't know...

I want to play with you guys
sometime. With the Digimon too,
of course!
dialog.translation:
Me gustaría jugar con vosotros
alguna vez. ¡Y con los Digimon,
claro!
